component_evaluations.label: Character identity
component_evaluations.evaluation: Body/face/headband/rainbow tail remain recognizable; successful identity does not approve the motion.

component_evaluations.label: Costume/contour stability
component_evaluations.evaluation: Late gingham, apron/tail patches and contours crawl while the requested body stillness is otherwise maintained.

component_evaluations.label: Connected palm contact
component_evaluations.evaluation: Hands stay low, joined and near the basin rather than rising into A1 clasp. Finger detail remains small and soft.

component_evaluations.label: Reciprocal rubbing action
component_evaluations.evaluation: No clear two-stroke back-and-forth slide across the cupped palm. The sequence mostly holds the source pose; foam/bubble changes are not rubbing.

component_evaluations.label: Attention
component_evaluations.evaluation: Original forward gaze remains disconnected from the hands. No down-gaze repair was requested in this controlled prompt-only comparison.

component_evaluations.label: Fixture/tap/lather relation
component_evaluations.evaluation: Basin support and off tap remain recognizable; small foam/bubble changes occur near contact and slight fixture shimmer remains.

component_evaluations.label: Entry/exit contact
component_evaluations.evaluation: Low source contact remains at entry/exit, but late source contour/material drift prevents a seamless-loop claim.

component_evaluations.label: Whole motion reference
component_evaluations.evaluation: Better than clasping for contact; too static to demonstrate the intended action. Rejected below4.5. Current game action3.9 unchanged.
